consistency.sentence:
Take 0.1% of the ETH side of every buy and sell as a hook fee, settled in ETH inside the swap that paid it (mint a claim when the PoolManager cannot pay it directly), and send it to 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111. Expose claimFees(PoolId poolId) that anyone may call to redeem that pool's claims using the same distribution. Fees are computed on the amount actually traded; when the swap specifies its ETH amount and the pool fills only part of it, the swap reverts rather than overpaying.
Replace only the Swap fee block's rate schedule, for the same buy and sell swaps: the rate starts at 30.0% at the pool's first swap and decreases linearly over 30 minutes of block timestamp to the Swap fee's 0.1%, then stays there. It uses the Swap fee's recipient and distribution, settled in ETH; if Volatility fee also applies, the higher rate wins. Track the first-swap time separately by PoolId. Expose currentFeeBps(PoolId poolId) as a view. Fees are computed on the amount actually traded; when the swap specifies its ETH amount and the pool fills only part of it, the swap reverts rather than overpaying.
When the absolute pool price move over the last 60 seconds of block timestamp exceeds 5.0%, replace the Swap fee's rate with 3.0% for the same buy and sell swaps, using the Swap fee's recipient and distribution, settled in ETH. Otherwise use the Swap fee's rate schedule. If Fee that fades also applies, the higher rate wins. Track price history and volatility separately by PoolId. Expose isVolatile(PoolId poolId) as a view. Fees are computed on the amount actually traded; when the swap specifies its ETH amount and the pool fills only part of it, the swap reverts rather than overpaying.
Collect 4.9% of the ETH side of every swap into a jar held by the hook, tracked separately by PoolId and settled in ETH inside the swap that paid it (mint a claim when the PoolManager cannot pay it directly). When the jar holds at least 0.1 ETH, anyone may call buyback(PoolId poolId). Buy only inside buyback(), never inside a swap, from this same pool, with a price limit 3% above the pool price at the start of the call; keep any unspent ETH in that pool's jar and anyone may call it again. attempt to burn with the token's burn(uint256); if it has none, or the burn call reverts, keep them in the hook forever; no function can move retained tokens. Expose jar(PoolId poolId) as a view. Fees are computed on the amount actually traded; when the swap specifies its ETH amount and the pool fills only part of it, the swap reverts rather than overpaying.
consistency.message: The highest simultaneous ETH-side hook fees total 34.9%. Include fade and volatility replacement rates; the total must stay at or below 5%.
